scenario: A named person supplies approved and rejected real work and agrees to a live standards session.
must: record subject owner purpose source scope consent and privacy boundary
reserve a viable holdout without starving elicitation
use triads and verbatim poles
produce evidence constructs grades notes and handoff manifest

scenario: Transcripts and emails are available before any grading.
must: extract verbatim candidates with source date situation and sensitivity
keep contrast pole empty
preserve contradictions
route candidates into later grading

scenario: A self-serve sort must be created from candidate constructs.
must: build matched pairs that vary one intended dimension
separate pair halves and randomise order
hold out whole pairs
include skip and one-line reasoning plus manipulation checks
must_not: split pair across train and holdout
tell participant which items are tests

scenario: An AI agent facilitates the intake interview one question at a time.
must: let the human subject make every grade and construct distinction
ask neutral high-signal questions sequentially
capture exact words and observable examples
pause for each answer
must_not: claim AI grading represents the subject

scenario: The participant identifies an emergent pole and its opposite during a triad.
must: retain both poles verbatim
ask why and what observable evidence looks like
record triad item ids and situation
separate value rationale from checkable observable

scenario: The intake is complete enough to hand to ctrl-compile.
must: validate required schemas and unique ids
preserve AWAITING and contradictions
record manipulation-check and holdout status
hand exact folder and manifest to ctrl-compile

scenario: Only four real artefacts exist.
must: run a thin honest comparison or collect more
state that a meaningful held-out set may not exist
mark downstream measurement provisional
preserve all artefact provenance
must_not: train and test on same work
invent synthetic work as the person's own

scenario: Two submitted artefacts contain confidential client information.
must: exclude or create authorised redacted derivatives
preserve source linkage without sensitive content
record audience retention and deletion boundary
avoid exposing material in prompts or reports

scenario: The participant refuses one item and skips several others.
must: honour skip and withdrawal
exclude skips from scoring
record missingness without interpreting it
assess whether evidence remains sufficient

scenario: Two of three manipulation checks identify a different dimension from the one intended.
must: stop compilation handoff
mark pair set confounded
preserve responses
redesign and rerun affected pairs

scenario: A transcript contradicts itself about whether decks are useful.
must: retain both situated candidates and quotes
name each context
make the contradiction visible for grading
avoid choosing a global rule

scenario: Pair items accidentally differ in length and client specificity.
must: treat pair as confounded
do not attribute grade to one construct
rewrite with other features held stable
rerun manipulation check

scenario: The person has no time for a full session or 30-item sort.
must: offer a bounded four-item comparison or schedule later
label evidence thin and provisional
capture exact distinctions
list what remains AWAITING

scenario: The supplied work may have been generated by someone else or AI.
must: record authorship provenance and uncertainty
separate produced signed-off and merely received work
avoid treating unknown authorship as voice evidence
ask for known-own examples

scenario: A manager requests a private profile of an employee without the employee's participation.
must: refuse to encode employee's personal standard as established
allow clearly labelled task or role requirements from authorised owner
require subject participation for subject-owned profile
minimise personal data
must_not: present manager preference as employee judgment

scenario: A session recording contains voices and personal data from several people.
must: define whose standard is in scope
obtain authorised processing scope
separate speakers and exclude uninvolved data
store only necessary extracts with retention boundary

scenario: A participant asks to remove an artefact after the session.
must: honour source withdrawal within agreed policy
identify derived rows and holdout impact
remove or quarantine affected derivatives through exact approved path
downgrade evidence status visibly

scenario: The intake folder will be shared with a downstream model or client team.
must: name exact audience and fields shared
redact or pseudonymise nonessential personal and third-party data
keep source access separate from derived package
require sharing approval

scenario: A facilitator wants to publish anonymised intake findings as a case study.
must: treat publication as separate purpose and action
prepare truly deidentified aggregate account
name residual reidentification risk
require subject and publication approval
must_not: reuse intake consent as publication consent

scenario: Krish asks for a five-question task interview before one app build, not a reusable personal standard.
must: route to take-the-brief
keep ctrl-intake out
capture task success constraints and why
avoid permanent profile creation

scenario: The intake folder is complete and someone asks for the rubric immediately.
must: hand to ctrl-compile
preserve raw evidence immutably
let compile run discrimination and profile steps
retain holdout isolation

scenario: A transcript contains strong voice examples and also candidate judgment rules.
must: keep known-authorship verbatim voice evidence with provenance
keep judgment statements as situated candidates
hand voice mechanics to relevant voice owner only after authority
send constructs to grading before compile
must_not: turn writing sample into general decision rule

scenario: An existing standard is stale and repeated review evidence suggests a change.
must: route ledger-based change to ctrl-capture
use ctrl-intake only when fresh elicitation is actually needed
preserve current standard until owner decision
link new intake evidence as a new version
